summary: The implementation successfully delivers all Stage 1 requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-8) with working code, correctly stubs Stage 2 requirements (REQ-9 and REQ-10) with proper function signatures and TODO markers, and documents Stage 3 features (REQ-11) with comprehensive TODO comments. However, the backend main.mo file is truncated, preventing full verification of all backend implementation details. Based on visible evidence, most requirements appear to be implemented correctly.

missing_requirements.requirement: /sitemap.xml route that generates valid XML sitemap from pages array
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend sitemap page exists and displays routes, but no explicit evidence of /sitemap.xml XML generation endpoint in the truncated backend file

hallucinated_features.description: Additional /onboarding route not specified in REQ-1 requirements
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 specifies exactly five routes (/, /contact, /sitemap, /products, /services), but the application implements a sixth route /onboarding
